channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: 14 of our favorite new burgers in the Twin Cities to close out 2025
item.description: Craggy edges, special sauce and kimchi-spiced — there’s a lot of love to find between two toasted buns.

item.title: Greg Thayer, former Twins pitcher from St. Cloud, dead at 76
item.description: He pitched in 20 games for his home-state team in 1978 after a standout college career at St. Cloud State.

item.title: Snoop Dogg, Lainey Wilson, ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ singers headline Vikings Christmas halftime show
item.description: The Vikings host the Lions at 3:30 p.m. Thursday, which will stream on Netflix.

item.title: Big retailers like Target increasingly hit by online refund fraud rings; one Minnesotan charged in one scam
item.description: Retailers are losing millions of dollars to fraud, including a case involving a Northfield-area man who’s expected to plead guilty

item.title: Analysis: A position-by-position overview of the Twins 40-man roster
item.description: FanGraphs and ESPN projection systems view the Twins roster as one that is flawed, but currently expected to win around 80 games.

item.title: Minnesota woman wins $65 million lawsuit over asbestos in talc products
item.description: A Ramsey County jury found Johnson & Johnson products exposed her to asbestos and caused her to develop mesothelioma.

item.title: Northern Minnesota utility drops plan to use energy from controversial Wisconsin gas plant
item.description: Minnesota Power said the Nemadji Trail Energy Center in Superior, Wis., has been delayed too long by litigation and permitting.

item.title: Fairview says it’s owed $100M by UCare as court orders consumer protections for patients
item.description: A Ramsey County judge backed a state petition for ‘rehabilitation’ at the health insurer, which ultimately will be liquidated.

item.title: Takeaways: Anthony Edwards hits go-ahead three late as Timberwolves overcome Chris Finch’s ejection to top Thunder
item.description: The Wolves scored the final eight points of the game to hand defending NBA champion Oklahoma City only its third loss of the season.

item.title: Walz says there’s no evidence of $9B in fraud, exposing rift between state and feds
item.description: The statements exposed tensions that have been simmering between Walz and Joe Thompson, the federal prosecutor who has led the fraud investigations.
